pkgmetadata.longdescription: Kernelsmith detects your hardware and walks you through building a slim, optimized kernel (BORE, ThinLTO, AutoFDO, NTSYNC, native CPU tuning, localmodconfig) with plain-language explanations. It installs through installkernel, rebuilds out-of-tree modules such as nvidia-drivers, supports OpenRC and systemd, and uninstalls the kernels it built cleanly. It can also hand your settings to a Portage distribution kernel via /etc/kernel/config.d.
